metadata.question: Did the total water surface area within a 5 km radius of Agudo, Brazil increase between November 5, 2023 and November 21, 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use JRC Global Surface Water or Dynamic Surface Water for water detection - Alternatively, use Sentinel-2 with NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) - Location: Agudo, Brazil (~-29.65°S, -53.24°W) - Dates: November 5, 2023 and November 21, 2023 - Geometry: 5 km radius buffer around Agudo 2. Masking strategy: - Cloud masking is crucial since we're looking at water surfaces - Use Sentinel-2 QA60 band for cloud masking - Calculate NDWI = (Green - NIR) / (Green + NIR) - Threshold NDWI > 0 for water 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid zero: Water area can legitimately be 0 or increase/decrease - C1: No images found for one or both dates - C2: Images exist but after cloud masking, no valid pixels remain - C3: Calculation returns null/undefined or invalid values - Compare water areas: if area_nov21 > area_nov5, answer A; else B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const agudo = ee.Geometry.Point([-53.24, -29.65]); const aoi = agudo.buffer(5000); // 5 km radius const date1 = '2023-11-05'; const date2 = '2023-11-21'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBit = 1 << 10; const cirrusBit = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBit).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBit).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } function addNDWI(image) { const ndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); return image.addBands(ndwi); } // Get images for both dates const col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(3, 'day')) .map(maskClouds) .map(addNDWI); const col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(3, 'day')) .map(maskClouds) .map(addNDWI); const size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Nov 5 images: ${size1}, Nov 21 images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('No images found for one or both dates.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Get median composite and extract water const img1 = col1.median(); const img2 = col2.median(); const water1 = img1.select('NDWI').gt(0); const water2 = img2.select('NDWI').gt(0); // 4. Calculate water areas with pixel counting const count1 = await water1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); const count2 = await water2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log(`Valid pixels - Nov 5: ${count1}, Nov 21: ${count2}`); console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } const area1 = await water1.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); const area2 = await water2.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (area1 === null || area2 === null || isNaN(area1) || isNaN(area2)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid results.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const area1_km2 = area1 / 1e6; const area2_km2 = area2 / 1e6; console.log(`Nov 5, 2023 water area: ${area1_km2.toFixed(2)} km2 (Pixels: ${count1})`); console.log(`Nov 21, 2023 water area: ${area2_km2.toFixed(2)} km2 (Pixels: ${count2})`); console.log(`Change: ${(area2_km2 - area1_km2).toFixed(2)} km2`); if (area2 > area1) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```

<answer>C1</answer>
